thread.title: Will Tech Stocks Like Apple Ever Come Down to Earth? TheStreet's Newsroom Discusses

author: thestreet.com
title: Will Tech Stocks Like Apple Ever Come Down to Earth? TheStreet's Newsroom Discusses
text:
The stock market is on fire again. Shocker. 
Investors have quickly moved beyond the February correction, Trump tariffs and a host of other concerns to send stocks higher. As no surprise, tech stocks such as Action Alerts Plus holding Apple ( AAPL ) and Netflix ( NFLX ) are leading the latest charge. 
TheStreet's newsroom looks at what could be in store for tech stocks on 'Jolt'. We also chat with TheStreet's sister publication The Deal about private equity money floating around several spaces. And the Action Alerts Plus research team has a host of must-see charts on the market.
